upstream.description: World-model-as-a-harness for simulating AI agent environments

classification.analysis: World Model Optimizer (wmo): a Python CLI and server that uses LLM-simulated agent environments (world models) to test and improve agents. It turns collected OTel agent traces into routers across frontier and smaller models (reported 27% lower cost on RouterBench), distills small open models via the Tinker API, and optimizes agent harnesses (prompts, tools, skills) in E2B sandboxes with closed-loop evaluation. Includes SWE-bench, tau-bench and terminal-task cookbooks. For teams tuning agent cost and quality.

use_cases.title: Route requests between frontier and cheaper models from your traces
Simulate an agent environment with an LLM world model for testing
Optimize an agent harness against simulated tasks with eval gates
Distill a small open model from collected agent traces
Run agent evals in isolated E2B sandboxes
